name: axe-check
description: Run @axe-core/playwright's WCAG 2 A/AA ruleset against a consumer's own axe results or a running site

scripts.build: esbuild index.js --bundle --platform=node --target=node18 --format=esm --minify --external:playwright --external:@axe-core/playwright --banner:js="import { createRequire as __cr } from 'module'; const require = __cr(import.meta.url);" --outfile=dist/index.js

author: alcash55
